title: Amtrak records eight final station completions in the six-month cohort
summary: Amtrak reports eight named station projects reached final completion between November 1, 2025 and April 30, 2026. Denominator: Eight named final-completion projects in the reporting window: Albany, Camden, Columbus, Detroit Lakes, Devils Lake, Fort Morgan, Mount Pleasant, and Tomah.
